notes.title: Update v. 1.6.0
notes.content:
Greetings to the researchers!

This update is aimed at improving the user experience gained by the player in the game. The list can be found below.

Here is the list of changes for the current update:


 A new soundtrack has been written for the game.
 Added small situational gameplay mechanics
 TVs have been added to the game, broadcasting a new late-night radio show (expansion of the game plot)
 New small additional segments with testing of the protagonist have been added between chapters
 The laboratories have been visually improved
 Fixed an old bug with character collision
 Other fixes and improvements!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699621/8348b944c2e7a36f72ae7c50155d778e80a0755c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699621/6fa170bed61d5523b56d76410fcbef115458c36f.png

The old tracks have been completely removed from the game. You can see the new soundtrack below.

store.steampowered.com/app/3562610

notes.title: Update v. 1.5.0
notes.content:
Greetings to the researchers!

This update is primarily focused on significantly improving the game's performance (optimization), while also slightly expanding the game's plot. Now there are computers in the game, interacting with which you can get a printout of a message sent by an employee by internal mail.

Here is the list of changes for the current update:


 Significant optimization improvement (the frame rate has increased by up to 2 times at some levels)
 A slight expansion of the story
 Added an option to customize the display of "PLAY" (now hidden by default)
 Other small but significant changes ;)


Another concept art for the game

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699621/df29ab881680a80b89591dac9d841f6a65b25212.jpg

notes.title: Update v. 1.3.1
notes.content:
Greetings researchers,
Here is the list of changes for the current update:


 The game has been ported to Unreal Engine 5
 Added localization
 Lighting has been redesigned on some maps
 Post-processing has been changed
 From now on, the documents immediately get into the inventory
 Improved control settings
 And much more!


New interface localization languages:

 Russian
 German
 Spanish

The list of languages will be expanded in the future!

In case of problems with the new version of the game, you can always roll back to version 1.2.3. Just go to the beta section of the game and select version ue4-v.1.2.3
